profile.summary: Computer Systems Engineer with 25+ years of experience in software development, IT infrastructure, and project management. Skilled in ERP systems (BaaN, MFG/PRO), Windows, UNIX, Web and cloud environments, with expertise across the full software development lifecycle. Experienced in leading multicultural teams, recognised for strong analytical and communication skills, and committed to leveraging emerging technologies to deliver high-quality, efficient solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Activities: Development, lead and Production Support. 
Software development for the billboard advertising market, including billboards and airport displays. Development and production support of Microsoft applications using WPF, C#, Blazor, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, .NET Core, and SQL Server. Implementation of Amazon AWS services such as S3, SQS, Lambda, Quicksight, CloudWatch, EC2, and Azure DevOps. Developed automated reporting processes that reduce manual effort by 80%, enabling the generation of reports directly into PDF format. Software development also includes real-time computer vision applications. Served as a tech lead while remaining hands-on with development.

Global application support and development team within Global Business Services, a Centre of Excellence located in Queretaro, Mexico, providing support to business units worldwide.

positions.title: .NET Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
State Registry of Beneficiaries of Social Programs in Guanajuato state. This system consolidates all beneficiaries of social programs in Guanajuato into an SQL Server database. It processes and analyses approximately 50 million records using Business Intelligence tools such as QlikView, Tableau, pivot tables, reports, and charts on a web-based platform. Technologies and skills utilised: Visual Basic 6, VB.NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Crystal Reports, C#, jQuery, Ajax, HTML, CSS, design patterns, WCF, Microsoft Analysis Services, Highcharts, Android. Experienced in Scrum methodology, UML, project coordination and implementation, staff management, and leading IT teams.
Projects: 
- Administrative Social Information System 
- Register and Control System for Civil Associations in Guanajuato state. 
- Software development to control progress levels of social projects. 
- Info City Tourist Application for iPhone, developed in Objective-C and SQLite Database.
